delivery.state: running; separate from this display correction

upstream_review.observed: Stable7.3.4 published2026-11-10;7.2.15 upstream EOL. Current native MoOS base carries vendor7.3.3, already locally built. Qualify it through signed image/artifact delivery; raw upstream tarball is not a signed downstream kernel.
Kernel attribute reads invoke native callbacks; native EDID byte readback, not inode size, determines identity.
Keep vendor-ID matching and signed LVFS metadata. Automatic metadata/device discovery is distinct from applying device firmware.
Upstream reports3.x DP-to-HDMI detection regressions. This is a lead, not proof of the V3 dock/monitor root cause; no speculative downgrade or DDC override applied.
Use critical-chain/time with service dependency context. Current21.759s sample is not a repeatable performance comparison.

limitations: No installed adapter mutation or hardware brightness acceptance
No new instant hotplug daemon; existing timer notices changed identity at its next run
No new boot artwork or measured boot speedup
Source branch not a signed four-edition update
